description: This file defines the Generator class responsible for generating HTML documentation pages from a directory tree, including static assets, search index, and content rendering. It includes methods for recursive generation, sanitization of content, and handling configuration rebasing.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating static HTML documentation pages with support for recursive directory traversal, content sanitization, and search index creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Generator with a Daux instance, sets up configuration and template renderer.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns available content types, currently only Markdown.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Coordinates the overall generation process, including copying static assets, generating pages recursively, and creating search index.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Removes HTML tags, scripts, styles, and block elements from text, then collapses whitespace, for indexing purposes.

methods.name: generateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively traverses directory structure to generate individual HTML pages or copy raw files, updating search index as needed.

methods.name: generateOne
methods.description: Generates a single page from a node (file or directory), returning a Page object containing the content.
